  • Outdrive Collective Open
    Date: Saturday, October 10th, 2026
    Location: Stonecreek Golf Club
    Time: Registration at 7:00am, Shotgun Start at 8:00am
    Format: 4-Person Scramble
    Cost: $150/per player
     
    Excitement is in the air! Get ready to be part of something extraordinary at OutDrive Collective's Charity Golf Tournament. It's an event like no other, and we want you to be there! 🎉

    Join us for our first-ever Charity Golf Tournament on Monday, October 19th at Stonecreek Golf Club. Not only will you be golfing in great weather in Phoenix, but you will be joined by other golf enthusiasts who share the love for the game. The day includes access to the putting green and range starting at 7:00 a.m., a shotgun round of golf, an after-golf reception including an award ceremony, food and refreshments, raffle prizes, and silent auction items.

    Hole-in-One Contest (Holes 5, 15), chance to win $10,000
    Longest Drive Contest
    Closest to the Pin

    Full calendar of events:

    100% of proceeds raised will go toward Dr. Rafael Fonseca's Cancer Research program at Mayo Clinic, Arizona.

    About OutDrive Collective
    The Outdrive Collective (a 501c(3) nonprofit organization) was founded by Andrew Kung to blend his love for golf with a mission to give back – especially to families impacted by cancer. He is passionate about harnessing the power of sport to drive meaningful change and build community. Andrew’s goal is to inspire the next generation to take the lead in supporting cures, care, and community – all while swinging for something greater.

    About Mike’s Pro Barber Shop (Scottsdale, AZ)
    Mike is more than just a legend and master barber – he’s a trusted voice, a mentor, and a community pillar in the Phoenix/Scottsdale area. As the owner of Mike’s Pro BarberShop, Mike has cultivated a space that goes far beyond the chair, creating a cultural hub where stories are shared, friendships are forged, and lives are uplifted. A passionate advocate for youth, families, and mental wellness, Mike uses his platform to support causes close to his heart. His hands-on leadership and unwavering dedication to community service make him a natural partner in bringing the Outdrive Open to life –uniting neighbors for a day of golf, giving, and grounded connection.

    Thank you for supporting our mission; your support is invaluable!

    Back by popular demand, join us for the second annual Ryan House Open Golf Tournament, a high-energy, fun-filled day that blends friendly competition with an incredible cause. After a sold-out debut last fall, we’re thrilled to return to the beautiful Legacy Golf Club in Phoenix for another elevated experience, complete with surprises, contest holes, and plenty of moments to enjoy on and off the course.

    About Ryan House:
    Ryan House enriches the quality of life and creates cherished memories for children and their families, providing a much-needed break from 24/7 caregiving as they navigate life-limiting or end-of-life journeys. Ryan House is the only facility of its kind in the state and only one of three in the country. For more information, visit ryanhouse.org.   • 2026 FORE! PAWS Golf Tournament
     
    Date: Friday, May 1st, 2026
    Location: Papago Golf Club

    Arizona Golden Rescue is an all-volunteer, non-profit 501(c) (3), charitable organization whose mission is to rescue displaced Golden Retrievers and mostly-Golden Retriever mixes that may have been abused, abandoned, neglected, unwanted, or surrendered by their owners due to previously unforeseen circumstances and to find new, permanent homes for them. Rescued dogs are given a complete veterinary exam, and their vaccines are updated. They are also microchipped, spayed or neutered, and tested for valley fever and heartworm. The rescued dogs are then placed into Foster homes or "Foster With Intent To Adopt" homes until they are permanently placed with their new "Forever Homes." Arizona Golden Rescue is a "Non-Shelter Rescue" with all dogs staying in Foster homes till adopted.

  • Gift of Adoption's 4th Annual Fore the Love of Families TopGolf Tournament & Social
     
    Date: Thursday, May 14th, 2026
    Location: TopGolf Scottsdale
    Time: 6pm
    Cost: $100/per player, $500/per team of 6, $50/per spectator (no golf play)
    Format: TopGolf Tournament

    Help deserving children find permanency through adoption! Attend Gift of Adoption Arizona's Fore the Love of Families TopGolf Tournament & Social to raise money for adoption assistance grants!

    Every child deserves the security of a permanent, loving home, but you don't need to adopt to give a child or young adult a family! Sometimes, all it takes is a great night at TopGolf!

    Did you know that worldwide over 153 million children are awaiting adoption? That's more than half the population of the United States, yet financial barriers are often to blame for children not getting the permanent, loving family they deserve and need to thrive.

    That's where Gift of Adoption Fund steps in. We provide adoption assistance grants to supply life-changing financial aid to families in the final stages of the adoption process. These critical funds help families "cross the finish line," so they can welcome a child, sibling group, or young adult, into their family for good.

    Gift of Adoption invites individuals and corporations to participate in this important work; every dollar we have to give to a family in need is a dollar we first receive from people like you! Please join us at our 4th Annual Fore the Love of Families TopGolf Tournament & Social to help us raise funds for families in Arizona seeking to complete their adoptions.

    At the happy-hour-inspired event, golfers—individuals or in teams of six—compete for prizes and bragging rights. And we'll do it all to give children the priceless gift of family!

    Golfers and spectators alike can participate in an exciting silent auction, 50/50 raffle, longest drive contest, and cocktail hour, food and refreshments, and lots of fun! So bring your friends, your A-game, and a generous heart for a night of impact for families in Arizona.

    ACT FAST! Spots go fast, and space is limited! Early Bird Pricing runs out on May 5th!

  • Trellis Katie Girse Memorial Golf Classic
    Date: May 21st, 2026
    Location: Arizona Biltmore Golf Club
    Time: 7:30am Shotgun Start, 2pm Luncheon
    Format: Scramble
    Cost: $200/per player, $750/per foursome
     
    Join us for a day of golf, networking, and fundraising at the Biltmore! The event raises funds to support Trellis' mission of making stable homes and communities possible through learning, lending, and building. The event includes a round of golf, a cart, a grab-and-go breakfast, lunch, and two beverage tickets. Registration also includes prizes for 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place foursomes as well as winners of Closest-to-the-Pin, Longest Drive, and Putting Contests.

    Katie Girse was a Project Coordinator in our Real Estate Development Department at Trellis, where her work contributed to creating housing for low- to- moderate income families and individuals across Arizona. She was so dedicated to Trellis’ mission that she also gave personally, contributing from every paycheck to support the organization she loved. Her generosity touched colleagues, partners, and the families we serve. On Aug. 30, 2025, Katie passed away after a rapid decline from cervical cancer.
